subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Photo Recognition at Scale
description: A 60-second lesson on Photo Recognition at Scale.

hook.text: You upload a photo. The platform identifies your face, your friends' faces, and the restaurant in the background.

buildup.text: AI image recognition detects faces, locations, brands, food, mood, and activities in every photo you upload.

discovery.text: Facebook's DeepFace system identifies faces with 97% accuracy — nearly matching human perception.

twist.text: Even photos where you're not tagged contribute data. The background reveals your lifestyle and habits.

climax.text: Every photo is a data source. The image shows your face; the metadata shows when and where you took it.

punchline.text: One photo. A thousand data points extracted.

quiz.question: What can AI extract from a photo uploaded to social media?
options: Faces, locations, brands, activities, and metadata like time and place
Only the file size and format
